maria: FYI hitting a repro where async stream generator never closes after an SSL reauth. sample app shows socket count growing until process OOM.

maria: repro steps: start sample app, call /stream twice, trigger token refresh (we use a short-lived test cert), then cancel client side.

maria: minimal snippet: ```py
async with Client(api_key=KEY) as client:
    async for chunk in client.stream("chat", prompt):
        if some_condition:
            break  # cancel
```

maria: log after cancel: ``socket: 102 -> 104, keepalive conn not reclaimed`` and trace shows generator finalizer not awaited: ``Task was destroyed but it is pending!``

kevin: ouch. is this the old finalizer/weakref case or a new reauth path?

maria: looks like reauth path. when the auth code swaps session._connector it leaves StreamReader with open transport. finalizer runs but doesn't call `await stream.aclose()` so transport stays open.

olga: i've seen a similar thing in the sample-app where the context manager exits before the token-refresh coroutine finishes. quick fix was to ensure ``__aexit__`` awaits any in-flight stream tasks.

kevin: could we make `stream()` return an asynccontextmanager wrapper that guarantees cleanup on cancel? that would be a UX win for sample app folks.

alex: i can prototype a tiny API: ```py
@asynccontextmanager
async def safe_stream(...):
    s = await client._start_stream(...)
    try:
        yield s
    finally:
        await s.aclose()
```

alex: downside: changes surface area a bit, but it's explicit. also helps typing: return AsyncIterator[bytes] vs raw generator.

sam: typing request: please annotate stream return type as `AsyncIterator[str] | AsyncIterator[bytes]` and export `Stream` alias in stubs. makes mypy/pyright happier. also add an integration test that simulates mid-stream reauth and ensures sockets drop.

kevin: agree on tests. target `tests/stream/test_reatuh_cleanup.py` with small HTTP server to trigger 401 then refresh. i've got a scaffold for that.

maria: i've started a tiny repro branch: 289-ssl-reauth-leak. i'll open PR once kevin's test scaffold is in.

alex: heads up, if you add `__aexit__` awaits, watch for deadlocks in teardown if aclose waits on a queue that consumer holds. best to use `asyncio.wait_for( ... , timeout=1.0)` in tests to avoid hangs.

maria: good call. will add a short timeout in the test.

dev-bot: CI report: build #4123 failed on linux-py310 — flake8: F811 redefinition in streaming.py (line 212).

alex: that's from my earlier refactor, fixing now. small PR incoming.

kevin: plan: (1) add test scaffold, (2) maria opens repro PR referencing scaffold, (3) alex pushes `__aexit__` cleanup with guarded timeout, (4) sam adds typing stubs and unit test for typing.

maria: sounds good. i'll link the repro in the PR and include heap/sock counts. thanks all :thumbsup:

dev-bot: CI #4127 green ✅ (linux-py310, tests/stream/* passed)

maria: moving to close — will follow up if anything else crops up during canary on staging.
